title: draba nivalis var. glabrescens
intro: Draba nivalis var. glabrescens, commonly known as Alpine Whitlow Grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-bacterial and anti-viral properties, which may aid in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Draba nivalis var. glabrescens include isothiocyanates and other glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
